verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://developer.bigcommerce.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 and includes a dedicated 'Instructions for AI Agent' section. First-party docs also advertise 'AI-ready page actions', and doc pages are served as .md variants (e.g. quick-start.md, tools-and-sdks.md) that an agent can consume directly. Missing for 10: evidence of how completely llms.txt covers the docs (e.g. an llms-full.txt), and independent corroboration of agents using it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://developer.bigcommerce.com/llms.txt # BigCommerce Docs
